title: Monster Character Table Substrate Filter
statement: The Monster group M has 194 irreducible representations. The character values of M at conjugacy classes indexed by W(3,3)-substrate-primitive primes (3A, 7A, 11A, 13A, corresponding to q, Phi_6, p_Ih, Phi_3) encode the complete substrate arithmetic in the Monster's representation ring. The smallest non-trivial representation has dimension 196883 = 47 * 59 * 71 (three Ogg supersingular primes). The McKay moonshine fingerprint concentrates at substrate-prime classes.
